Ford Mustang Shelby GT500 Races Chevrolet Corvette Z06 From 45 MPH, It's Close But Not Close Enough
14 photos
Photo: Import 2 Race / YouTube
We have been patiently waiting over the course of many weeks for the good folks over at the racing-focused ' Import 2 Race ' channel on YouTube to come back home to their traditional venue - Island Dragway in Great Meadows, New Jersey.
That still hasn’t happened, and there’s still no sign of seeing them home any time soon to check out new quarter-mile dragstrip skirmishes. Instead, they found a massive passion for the lesser-known sport of roll races – initially, we have been treated to a series of 65-mph roll race battles, with all the high-speed action taking place at the iconic Pocono Raceway , a 2.5-mile tri-oval track in Blakeslee, Pennsylvania.
Later on, the videographer did make a change of scenery, though not also of the racing format. As such, while they’re still not back at Island Dragway, they are at least inching closer, and have shown us a new series of 45-mph roll races from the 2026 Sunday Funday Mod2Fame event . The action took place at an airport in Sullivan County, New York, with the format being the 45-mph roll race variety because, obviously, their strip isn’t as long as the massive straight at Pocono.
There’s no scoreboard either, so we have to rely on the rather unreliable natural eyesight, and such there’s also no way of knowing the actual roll speeds. At least the protagonists are feisty: we have seen the S650 Ford Mustang Dark Horse, the C8 iteration of the Chevrolet Corvette ZR1, the Ford Mustang Shelby GT500 from the S550 series, tuned ‘Vettes, and even older stuff like the Cadillac CTS-V.
Now, the latest skirmish involves a white and black-accented S550 Ford Mustang Shelby GT500 rocking the mighty Predator 5.2-liter supercharged V8 as it goes up against a blue Chevrolet Corvette Z06 of the C7 variety, thus packing the traditional front-engine V8 and RWD. This was an interesting skirmish, of course, featuring archrivals that go for different values when it comes to the sports car phenomenon – the raw, brute force of the Shelby clashes with the elegant power delivery of the nimbler C7 Corvette.
Anyway, there is only one possible outcome – someone is going home victorious. Both sports cars looked composed as they prepared to unleash their roaring V8s, and once they floored the accelerator pedal, it was pretty clear that on the unprepped tarmac, all bets are off. In the end, we didn’t need a photo finish despite the admirable efforts of the underdog.
So, the Shelby GT500 reconfirmed its status and narrowly beat the pursuing Z06, which was close – but not close enough. Of course, in the present, the status of liberties and the balance of power might be a little different, but we’ll have to wait and see if anyone catches a skirmish between the newer Dark Horse SC and the C8 Corvette Z06.
